svg.title: OnboardMimic 系统架构 / System architecture
svg.desc: OnboardMimic Lab 数据工作台通过接口连接 OnboardMimic；OnboardMimic 管理控制权和回放调度，WBC 通过独立保护桥控制机器人。OnboardMimic Lab connects to OnboardMimic through APIs. OnboardMimic manages control ownership and replay timing; WBC commands pass through an independent protection bridge.
